wholePhysicalScope: Native building footprints 17693566, 89642573, 474662465 and 95714848, mapped retaining-wall ways, exact public-domain images reviewed alongside Forsvarsbygg’s conservation register, and sampled original hillside elevation.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the white Donjon, shaped stone ramparts and preserved supporting buildings.
limitations: Bastion crest and backfill levels and the Donjon’s section are interpreted from the map, terrain and exterior photographs. The model covers the principal group and preserves the outline of the angular fort. Interiors and detached equipment are outside the model.
